adminOnly.title: Admin only
adminOnly.body: The relationship graph exposes a user's full network, so it's restricted to the admin role.

title: Relationship explorer
intro: The whole user network — linked by care-circle and shared channels, colored by behavior, sized by connections. Search or click a node for details, or switch to One User to map a single person's world.
hint3d: drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · click a node to open it

ego.searchPlaceholder: Search a user by email or name…
ego.pickPrompt: Search and pick a user above to render their relationship graph.
ego.empty: This user has no children, care-circle, behaviors, or community activity yet.
ego.clickToInspect: Click a node to inspect it.

search.placeholder: Find a person in the graph…

population.emptyBody: The population graph links users who share a care-circle or a channel. With {count} {count, plural, one {user} other {users}} and no cross-links yet, there's no network to draw — it fills in as your user base grows and connects.
population.help2d: Search or click a node to open its details · hover to spotlight connections · scroll to zoom · drag to pan or move a node. Node size = connections; purple edges = care-circle, grey = shared channels.
population.help3d: Search or click a node to open its details · drag to orbit · scroll to zoom. Node size = connections; purple links = care-circle, grey = shared channels.
